actual_prerequisite.limits: The SQLAlchemy failure is observed; the proposed small reproducer and explanatory cell-initialization mechanism have not been executed or IR-dumped. No performance or current full97 claim.

static_findings: The complete collect_expression_captures function in lower.cpp:2092-2244 handles literal ListExpr/SetExpr/DictExpr, GeneratorExpr and LambdaExpr; it has no ListCompExpr/SetCompExpr/DictCompExpr branch.

FunctionLowerer constructor calls prepare_captured_locals before lowering statements. store_named_value emits StoreCell only for an already identified cell local. lower_function_value may discover the child's free name and ensure its parent cell later. finish has no general earlier StoreLocal-to-StoreCell conversion.

scope_analysis.cpp does traverse eager comprehension expressions when discovering child free reads. The VM load_free branch raises the observed message when an existing free Cell contains Invalid. Together these source facts support a missed early cell-initialization hypothesis.

The generator control uses the existing GeneratorExpr collector branch. The ordinary control directly reads its outer list. The failing-shape case puts that list only in the first iterable of an eager comprehension inside the returned lambda.

SQLAlchemy _row_as_tuple first constructs getters using methodcaller, then returns exactly a lambda whose tuple(list-comprehension) consumes getters. The small reproducer uses a literal list of ordinary functions to exclude operator and the preceding construction comprehension.
